_comment: How each surviving mutant was resolved: why no test caught it (cause) and what was done (fix). kind: 'test' (a new test kills it), 'code' (the code was changed or removed), 'equivalent' (it can't change any result; accepted, with a reason a reviewer can check). An entry matches a mutant in the same file whose source line or replaced code contains 'code' (and, if given, whose mutator is in 'mutators'). Add an entry for every survivor you resolve; the mutation report shows them next to each run.

resolutions.cause: No test passed text with something before or after a valid date, so dropping the ^ or $ anchor went unnoticed: '2026-10-07junk' would have been accepted.
resolutions.fix: Test 'accepts only the whole text as a date, nothing before or after it' (validate.edges.test.ts).

resolutions.cause: Equivalent: for a missing text any fallback string fails the date pattern the same way, so the result is null either way.
resolutions.fix: Accepted; no test can tell the two apart.

resolutions.cause: Equivalent: any month JavaScript rolls over also changes the year (month 00 or 13+) or the day (30 Feb becomes 2 Mar), so the month check never decides alone.
resolutions.fix: Accepted; the check is kept because 'year, month and day all match' is the plain round-trip check.

resolutions.cause: Equivalent: maximize() fills in a region for every locale Intl can parse, so the fallback is never used; an unknown region and '' both give a Monday week start.
resolutions.fix: Accepted; no input reaches the fallback.

resolutions.cause: Equivalent: an empty catch block also returns undefined.
resolutions.fix: Accepted; no test can tell the two apart.

resolutions.cause: Equivalent: without the return, parsed stays undefined and the typeof check right after returns false all the same.
resolutions.fix: Accepted; the misplaced 'Stryker disable' comment was removed instead of fixed.

resolutions.cause: Tests used versions 1, 2 and 3 but never 0, so the lower limit (version < 1) wasn't pinned.
resolutions.fix: Test 'accepts format versions 1 and 2 (or none), and refuses anything else' with 0, 3, 1.5 and '1'.

resolutions.cause: No test sent a backup at or just over a size limit, so a limit could be off by one or ignored entirely.
resolutions.fix: Test 'accepts each list at its limit and refuses one record more', for all six lists.

resolutions.cause: Routes were always null in backup tests (no route cleaner), so duplicate and invalid routes were never exercised.
resolutions.fix: Test 'keeps the first of two routes with the same id and counts the second as dropped'.

resolutions.cause: Part of the route filter: routes were always null in backup tests, so keeping a valid route was never checked.
resolutions.fix: Test 'keeps the first of two routes with the same id and counts the second as dropped'.

resolutions.cause: Redundant check: sanitizeSettings already returns null when the backup has no settings or the app knows none, so no test could ever fail.
resolutions.fix: Removed the check; validateBackup calls sanitizeSettings directly. Golden and edge tests unchanged and green.

resolutions.cause: No test checked the dropped-record count with invalid records in several lists at once, so a wrong sign went unnoticed.
resolutions.fix: Test 'counts every dropped record, per list' with 1 to 6 invalid records per list.

resolutions.cause: Food ids use the absolute value of the hash, and flipping the sign of every character flips only the hash's sign, so the id tests couldn't see it.
resolutions.fix: Test 'hashes text like the web app' pins hash('ab') = 3105 and hash('hello') = 99162322 (Java's String.hashCode).

resolutions.cause: No saved meal in the tests had more than 20 items, so the cap wasn't pinned.
resolutions.fix: Test 'keeps at most 20 items' (25 in, 20 out).

resolutions.cause: No lab in the tests had value details, so the 'edited' flag was never checked.
resolutions.fix: Test 'marks a value as edited only when the backup says exactly true'.

resolutions.cause: No test used weight 0 (body-weight sets) or a negative weight, so the >= 0 limit wasn't pinned.
resolutions.fix: Test 'keeps weight 0 (body-weight sets) and refuses negative weights'.

resolutions.cause: No workout in the tests had more than 60 exercises, so the cap wasn't pinned.
resolutions.fix: Test 'keeps at most 60 exercises' (70 in, 60 out).

resolutions.cause: Equivalent: a text entry in the fallback list has no name, so it is skipped; the workout has no exercises either way.
resolutions.fix: Accepted; no test can tell the two apart.

resolutions.cause: Equivalent: a text entry in the fallback list has no weight or reps, so the set is dropped either way.
resolutions.fix: Accepted; no test can tell the two apart.

resolutions.cause: Equivalent: a duration of 0 is kept as 0 or replaced by the fallback 0, the same result.
resolutions.fix: Accepted; no test can tell the two apart.
